typography.instructions: Import Unbounded and Manrope from Google Fonts in the index.html or global CSS.

colors.strategy: Archetype 5: Luxury mixed with Warmth. Avoid generic purple gradients and stereotypical pink. Use a rich Ruby Red/Crimson as primary.

visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid generic purple. If used, prefer warm, subtle gradients like Ruby Red to Deep Crimson, heavily blurred. Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays (grain) for background surfaces to add premium tactile feel. Use only where appropriate to avoid clutter.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffused shadows (e.g., shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(217,22,86,0.15)] for primary actions).
visual_enhancers.borders: Soft, 1px nested borders matching parent surface hue. e.g., border-border/40.

layouts.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Generous padding for cards and sections.
layouts.cards: Swipe cards in Discover should have max-h-[75vh] to leave room for bottom nav and actions. Use overlapping absolute positioning for swipe stacks.
layouts.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom, backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80, z-50. Height h-16 or h-20 with flex justify-around items-center. Active tab color Primary, inactive Text Secondary.
layouts.app_container: Since it's a mobile-first PWA, wrap the main app routes (excluding Admin) in a max-w-md mx-auto container on desktop to simulate mobile bounds, with a subtle border and shadow.

motion.micro_interactions: Framer motion scale-up on 'Like', left/right swipe gestures with rotation and opacity mapping.
motion.page_transitions: Slide-in from right for deep links (Chats, Settings).
motion.buttons: Hover scale 1.02, active scale 0.95. transition-transform duration-200.
motion.toast: Use Sonner for all notifications (e.g., 'Подарок отправлен!', 'Новая симпатия!').

components.swipe_card: Tinder-like card structure with absolute positioning, framer-motion drag controls. Linear gradient overlay bottom-to-top bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent for text readability.
components.profile_header: Circular avatar, popularity meter SVG circle progress ring.
components.chat_bubble: Sender: rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm bg-primary text-primary-foreground. Receiver: rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm bg-surface text-text_primary.
components.coin_balance: Neumorphic or subtle glassmorphism card in Profile. Primary accent color.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary action button text has 4.5:1 ratio against primary color.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements, especially Bottom Nav icons and Chat actions.
accessibility.aria_roles: Proper role='button' and aria-label for icon buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

media.image_handling: Always use object-cover for avatars and profile cards. Hero cards must have a max-h-[80vh] on mobile to prevent blocking UI.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design mobile-first. For the PWA user experience, rely heavily on max-w-md mx-auto for desktop container to simulate a mobile app feel for non-admin pages.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF for backgrounds. Use the tinted variables defined.
Install and use framer-motion for swipe cards in the Discover screen.
Create the Bottom Nav as a reusable layout component wrapping the 5 main tabs.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., matching or sending gifts).
Use Shadcn UI for standard components like Admin Table, Settings toggles, and Inputs, but build custom swipe cards.
All text must be in Russian as per requirements (e.g., 'Главная', 'Поиск', 'Лайки', 'Чаты', 'Профиль').
Apply `data-testid` to all crucial elements like auth buttons, like/pass swipe buttons, bottom nav tabs, etc.
DO NOT use a fully transparent background on overlays, navbars, or headers. Use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent surface.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
